evidence.detail: The main loader allocates the static rs/n/e[] interface table from the decoded interface count plus expansion capacity, then constructs and stores each interface by numeric id.

The loader consumes R29 StreamLoader and Stream objects, decodes parent/interface ids and then branches by interface type to populate dimensions, children, sprites, fonts, models, inventory slots, scripts/comparisons and interaction metadata.

The class owns child-id/position arrays, item-id/amount arrays, Sprite and font/model references, action arrays, text/tooltip strings, spell/action metadata, scroll/layout state and numerous static builders for custom interfaces.
Exact v308 literals include interface-facing defaults/actions such as "Ok", "Select", "Continue", "Close", spell casting text, prayer sprites and equipment/interface resource names.

proposals.note: RSInterface preserves the classic client semantic identity of the global widget/interface definition object. Exact v308 loader/state behavior is primary authority.
